responsibility: Declares the extra machine modes required by the IA-64 backend and adjusts their ABI-visible layout. In particular it introduces XF, TF, and IA-64-internal RF floating modes, an OI integer mode for stack save areas, the CCI predicate condition-code mode, and vector modes, while patching size, alignment, and format differences for ILP32 versus LP64 and for HP-UX versus SysV expectations.
